get_environment_string: get the environment from a string name and return a GymEnv instance
get_environment_callable: get the environment from a callable factory function with keyword arguments
get_environment_gymenv: get the environment from an existing GymEnv instance without modification
get_environment_kwargs: get the environment by passing keyword arguments to a callable factory
get_environment_unsupported: get the environment and raise AttributeError for unsupported input types
